cards.card_text: But what if the people of the land hide their eyes?
cards.verse_text: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,

cards.card_text: If the people hide their eyes and don't put to death the man who gave his child to Molech, the LORD will set His face against that man and his ___.
cards.verse_text: then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.
